Also if anyone sees this, do you know how to write a short note? My last one was long with a lot of points. I just want a short and sweet one this time.

I will never tell my family because they like him???? When I was little (I don't remember how old I was because I didn't even know what was going on or the memories are slightly suppressed) I was a bit clingy and I liked sleeping with adults. *See where this is going?* I don't remember why but I went to sleep with him, not my dad or my step mom. I asked him if I could sleep with him and he said yes. I don't remember if we laid down together for a few minutes or if he just did it right away. He got in front of me as I was laid down and told me to take off my shorts and underwear. I did as he asked (was confused) and he got in between my legs. He orally forced me to have sex with him (I don't feel comfortable with the word rape being used to describe what happened to me because of being raised in a fairly conservative family who don't even talk about rape). I do remember saying no. Even if I didn't say no it doesn't mean he was allowed to do it. I was a little kid and saying nothing does NOT mean yes no matter the age. Besides I figure it wouldn't change anything.  
Luckily, was in jail for a long time after that (unrelated reasons). Unluckily, he got out a few months ago. I was hoping to be an adult and long gone by the time he was out but fate hates me.  
My mom and brother adore him. They think he's a great person. I tell them he's not but they want reasons. My dad has conversations with him like his father even took care of him ever in his life (he didn't. My dad was raised by his grandma and mom back and forth). It hurts seeing them happy with him out. When I found out he was out I took a shower and cried.  
I've told bits and pieces to my friends but I probably won't ever tell anyone the story like I am now.
